entries.description: A buyer-accepted or permissionlessly finalized verifier Pass credits the full escrow and posted bond to the seller for withdrawal.

A verifier Fail or Inconclusive verdict opens the seller's challenge window. Unchallenged, the verdict finalizes as a full refund with the seller bond returned. A seller challenge posts the signed challenger bond and hands the case to the deal's arbitrator contract, which rules Release or Refund inside the ruling window; the losing challenger forfeits the challenger bond, a ruling of Refund slashes the seller bond, and arbitrator silence past the ruling deadline executes the standing verdict with the challenger bond returned.

A Funded or Delivered deal whose deadline passes with no verdict is claimable by anyone via claimTimeout: the full escrow credits to the buyer and the posted bond returns to the seller. Once a verdict is recorded, claimTimeout is unreachable; the only clock is the challenge window from the verification time, so the challenge window always exists in full.

A revision-bound EIP-712 cancellation offer atomically accepted by the counterparty credits the full escrow to the buyer and the posted bond to the seller; during a dispute the challenger bond unwinds to whichever party posted it.
